summary: This bill requires clinical trials approved by the National Institutes of Health to set and meet diversity goals for participant recruitment and retention based on race, ethnicity, age, and sex, and mandates public reporting of these goals and outcomes.

scores.thoughts: This bill focuses on increasing diversity in clinical trials by setting recruitment goals, requiring data sharing, and launching public awareness campaigns. This directly impacts the quality and accessibility of healthcare by ensuring treatments are effective across diverse populations, thus strengthening the overall public health system.
